description: Joshua Sanders, the legendary spear knight who ended the Empire's long civil war, is betrayed by his own emperor, Kaiser, and faces death. At the moment of his death, his spear Lugia begins to shine and sends him back to his childhood. Reborn with all of his memories and experience, Joshua begins his second life determined to change his fate and take revenge on those who betrayed him.
author: Jo Husang
